research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: official frozen/current biographies, first speech, contemporary 2016 Abetz statement, ABC 2018 candidate profile, public professional profile index and historical Deloitte transparency report inspected. Searched both engines for hours, employment months, earlier Bushby work and employer structure.

Identity safeguard: American leadership consultant/author Claire Chandler of Talent Boost is a different person; her full-time career claims and dates were discarded. Staff vacancy advertisements from the senator office do not establish Chandler own employment hours.

No substantive full-time status, FTE, leave or election-campaign break evidence found for Deloitte. Indexed LinkedIn aggregate 5 years 3 months is not a validated full-time total or evidence for inventing start/end months. First speech says work continued until election, without an exact resignation date.

Deloitte private ownership supported by historical 2018 report rather than public client mix. Precise employing partnership/subsidiary remains unconfirmed. Secondary revolving-door summaries listing only 2014-16 omit later official roles and were not used to truncate the career.

Follow-up: public detailed professional chronology or employer records for Deloitte commencement/promotion/exit months and hours; campaign leave around 2018/2019 elections; Bushby staff dates and remuneration; any earlier/student casual jobs; student governance tenure/pay. Excluded party duties overlap Deloitte and are not added to private years.
APH direct opening returned Internal Error, while indexed official biography remained available. No access controls bypassed; no outreach. Year precision retained and gaps not converted to zero.

Follow-up2026-10-02: primary professional index narrows senior-analyst end toJune2018and exposesJanuary2017start conflicting with official2016. Retain both explicitly; no inventedJulyclient-manager start. AdjacentMarch2014–December2016unlabelledrange and aggregate5years3months are not used to invent full-time total.

Bushby staff chronology, student governance and campaign-leave searches gave no new attributable contract/hours evidence. Full-time search results in Mandarin concern unrelated job advertisements, not Chandler; Our Watch annual-report event list separates board chair from invited Senator, so no directorship inferred. Direct LinkedIn429Too Many Requests not retried; indexed primary evidence available. Next seek promotion letter, employment hours/leave and Bushby office records.

Follow-up2026-10-04: targeted public-profile, Deloitte, client-manager, Bushby-office and campaign searches repeated the official role sequence and the already recordedJanuary2017–June2018senior-analyst range. No safely attributable client-manager month endpoints, substantive hours, campaign leave, employing entity or Bushby contract dates were exposed. The aggregate five-year-three-month profile duration was not converted into inferred boundaries. No material fact changed; retain gaps and advance.
